sources.collection_method_en: Read directly from the repository tree at commit 0e856ea035 and areas recomputed in EPSG:4548. **This is the sole geometric source of every spatial conclusion here, and equally the limit of all of them**: the official polygon is unpublished, this boundary is inferred, and every derived reading must be recomputed as a whole once official geometry exists — registered as A-BOUNDARY-001.
sources.license_or_reuse_terms_en: Open-call material published by the repository. This package cites its wording and figures as given, copies no full text, and does not redistribute the original file.

sources.does_not_support_en: A provisional boundary, not a statutory redline. It may not be used for alignment, acquisition, land approval or tenure. Every area and distance derived from it is recomputed as a whole when the official polygon is published, not patched.

sources.usage: 本方案自采数据：对 open-city-ai/haidian 全部已合入方案做权威源普查（枚举 git tree 而非会滞后的 submissions-data.js），统计赛道申报分布、结构收敛度、元符号饱和度与 agent.json 生成方法披露字段的可机读性。
sources.publisher: open-city-ai/haidian 公开仓库（原始数据）；审计由本方案作者生成
sources.collection_method: census.py 枚举 GitHub git tree API 得到全部方案目录，逐份抓取公开 proposal.md front matter 与 agent.json；field_map.py 汇总统计。两脚本公开于本方案配套 Issue，可重跑复算。
sources.coverage: 截至 2026-08-13 的 793 份已合入方案，抓取成功 793/793，失败 0。同期 submissions-data.js 索引列 507 份：287 份在 git tree 而不在索引，1 份在索引而不在 tree——两个方向分开给，因为净差会把它们抵消掉。此前各次覆盖自 184 份起逐次增长（历次读数随包，见 `visual/assets/census_history.json` 与 `census.json`）；语料每日增长，引用前须重跑脚本复算。**本条的三个数由构建从 `census.json` 写入，不手敲**：此前它停在 338 份、索引滞后 29 份的那一次，而正文早已在引用第十七次的读数（E196）。
sources.transformations: 赛道申报取 front matter 的 tracks 字段；结构母题与元符号用中文关键词正则；model 字段按是否为占位符/空分桶，并按模型家族归并以计算写法离散度。
sources.limitations: 母题识别基于关键词正则，存在同义表述漏计，全部 share 为下界估计。model 字段为占位符或空只说明机器可读披露字段未填，不等于作者隐瞒模型；写法离散度不评价任何作者。语料随征集持续增长，引用任何数字前须重跑脚本复算。
sources.source_locator: submissions/<login>/<slug>/ 下的 proposal.md 与 agent.json，权威源为 GitHub git tree（非 gallery 索引）；此前本条同时带 url 与 source_url 两个字段且取值已不一致（https://github.com/open-city-ai/haidian），已合并为单一 url
sources.license_or_reuse_terms: 各方案由其作者按仓库征集条款公开发布。本包**不再分发任何方案的正文**：随包副本每条记录只保留 title、summary、tracks、proposal_bytes、model 与 model_family——即本包发布的数字实际用到的字段，其余一律裁掉。统计结果为本方案的自采测量，定级 background_only，引用时应重跑而非转引，因为语料每日增长。
sources.title: 全场已合入方案的可重跑普查（本方案自采）
sources.title_en: Re-runnable census of every merged proposal in the field (measured by this proposal)
sources.collection_method_en: census.py enumerates every proposal directory through the GitHub git tree API and fetches each public proposal.md front matter and agent.json; field_map.py aggregates. Both scripts are published in this proposal's companion Issue and can be re-run.
sources.license_or_reuse_terms_en: Each proposal is published by its own author under the repository's open-call terms. This package **redistributes no proposal's body text**: the shipped copy keeps only title, summary, tracks, proposal_bytes, model and model_family for each record — the fields the published figures actually use — and drops the rest. The statistics are this proposal's own measurement, graded background_only; cite them by re-running rather than by quoting, because the corpus grows daily.
sources.usage_en: This proposal's own measurement: an authoritative-source census of every merged proposal in open-city-ai/haidian (enumerating the git tree rather than the lagging submissions-data.js), counting declared track distribution, structural convergence, meta-symbol saturation, and how machine-readable the agent.json generation-method disclosure fields are.
sources.authority_level_note_zh: 本包自采的普查数据，不是「公开资料」——该表规范的是筛选和引用他人发布的资料，而这一条是本包自己的测量，其可信度由随包的可重跑仪器和逐次读数承担。
sources.does_not_support_zh: 自采语料统计只描述已合入方案的公开字段，**不评价任何方案的质量**，不作为空间结论或法定管控的证据；语料每日变动，任何引用须复算。
sources.does_not_support_en: The corpus census describes public fields in merged submissions only. **It judges no submission's quality**, is not evidence for a spatial conclusion or for statutory control, and the corpus changes daily, so any citation must be recomputed.
sources.timeliness_level_note_zh: T0：按组织方 `brief/source-quality-rules.md` 的定义——「2026 年发布，或项目征集期内发布」——本条是征集期内自采并逐次重跑的测量，取回日期随包（`census.json` 的 `retrieved`）。此前本条只在 `authority_level` 上写了「不属该表分档」，而 `timeliness_level` 整个字段缺省——**一条声称逐条给出两个分级的说明，漏了两条**（E202）。

sources.usage: 独立公共数据复核：用 OpenStreetMap 实际测绘的京张铁路遗址公园多边形与废弃铁路线形，检验仓库临时边界与实际地理的差异。
sources.publisher: OpenStreetMap contributors
sources.collection_method: analysis/osm_reference.py fetch 经 Overpass API 抓取（bbox 39.925,116.315,40.035,116.375）；同脚本 report 在 EPSG:4548 下计算面积、覆盖率与最近距离。生成脚本无法进包（入库格式白名单不含 .py），但**每一个已发布标量都可由随包的 `node visual/assets/check_osm.js` 从同一份坐标独立复算**——该脚本无依赖、不联网，自行实现投影，并在复算不出时拒绝而非猜测。抓取脚本另公开于配套 Issue。
sources.limitations: OSM 为众包数据，公园多边形可能只覆盖已建成并被测绘的一段，不等于规划全域；临时边界亦为推定。本方案只报告两者差异，不判定何者正确。官方 polygon 发布后本节全部结论失效并须整体重算。
sources.source_locator: Overpass API，bbox 39.925,116.315,40.035,116.375；2 条公园边界 way 与 16 条铁路 way，保留原始 way id；此前本条同时带 url 与 source_url 两个字段且取值已不一致（https://www.openstreetmap.org/ · Overpass API），已合并为单一 url
sources.license_or_reuse_terms: ODbL 1.0（开放数据库许可）。署名『© OpenStreetMap contributors』，并以相同许可提供。**本包确实再分发了原始数据的一个提取子集**：`visual/assets/osm_reference.json` 内含 2 条公园边界环、16 条铁路 way 的原始坐标与标签，以及本方案自身的两条临时边界环，共 275 个顶点，未做简化。该子集构成 ODbL 意义上的派生数据库（Derivative Database），因此本包整体以 ODbL 1.0 提供该部分数据，并保留原始 way id 以便追溯。此前此处写「不再分发原始数据库」，在坐标随包提交后即不成立，已改正。
sources.title: OpenStreetMap 京张铁路遗址公园与废弃铁路线形提取（本方案自采）
sources.title_en: OpenStreetMap extract of the Jing-Zhang railway heritage park and the disused alignment (measured by this proposal)
sources.collection_method_en: analysis/osm_reference.py fetches via the Overpass API (bbox 39.925,116.315,40.035,116.375); the same script computes areas, coverage and nearest distances in EPSG:4548. The generating script cannot enter the package (the intake format allowlist excludes .py), but **every published scalar can be recomputed independently from the same coordinates by the shipped `node visual/assets/check_osm.js`** — dependency-free, offline, implementing the projection itself, and refusing rather than guessing when it cannot reproduce a value. The fetch script is published in the companion Issue.
sources.license_or_reuse_terms_en: ODbL 1.0 (Open Database License). Attribution '© OpenStreetMap contributors', shared under the same licence. **This package does redistribute an extracted subset of the original data**: `visual/assets/osm_reference.json` holds the raw coordinates and tags of 2 park boundary rings and 16 railway ways, together with this proposal's own two provisional boundary rings — 275 vertices, unsimplified. That subset constitutes a Derivative Database under ODbL, so this package provides that portion under ODbL 1.0 and keeps the original way ids for traceability. This field previously said the original database was not redistributed, which stopped being true once the coordinates shipped; corrected.
sources.usage_en: An independent public-data cross-check: OpenStreetMap's surveyed polygon for the Jing-Zhang railway heritage park and the disused alignment, used to test how far the repository's provisional boundary sits from the actual geography.
sources.authority_level_note_zh: 众包地理数据，不属于该表列出的任何一档：它既不是政府或官方平台发布（A0/A1），不是权威媒体转载（A2），也不是对标机构报告（A3）；本包按自己的证据上限记为 background_only，并在 A-OSM-001 里写明其众包属性。**不套一个不合身的档次，比套上去更接近这份规则的用意。**
sources.does_not_support_zh: 众包测绘不是官方道路中心线、用地边界或权属界线；缺失只说明地图上没有，不等于现场没有。定级 background_only，只用于定位差异，**不判定谁对**。
sources.does_not_support_en: Crowd-sourced mapping is not an official centreline, land-use boundary or tenure line, and absence from the map is not absence from the ground. Graded background_only: it locates a discrepancy and **does not decide which side is right**.
sources.timeliness_level_note_zh: T0 指的是**取回时刻**（2026-08-08，在征集期内），不是底下那些众包编辑的年龄：OSM 的每个要素各有自己的最后编辑时间，本包没有逐要素取回该时间，因此不为其声称任何时效。这条区别写在这里，是因为把取回日期当作数据年龄，正是本包在别处拒绝的那种含糊。

sources.title: 中华人民共和国无障碍环境建设法

sources.usage: 把本方案的「无AI等价服务路径」从设计判断锚定为法定义务：该条要求提供医疗、保险、金融、水电气等服务的场所保留现场指导、人工办理等传统服务方式。
sources.title_en: Barrier-free Environment Construction Law of the People's Republic of China
sources.collection_method_en: The author read the full text on the authorised-release page of the China Government Network, checked the adoption date, effective date and chapter/article counts, and read Article 39 verbatim before citing its substance; the full text is not copied.
sources.license_or_reuse_terms_en: National law, public by law. This package cites only the substance of the article, with its number.
sources.usage_en: Anchors this proposal's non-AI equivalent service path as a statutory duty rather than a design judgement: the article requires places providing medical, insurance, financial, water, electricity and gas services to retain traditional means such as on-site guidance and human handling.
sources.does_not_support_zh: 该法确立无障碍与保留传统服务方式的义务，不规定本方案任何限差数值，也不认可任何具体空间做法或构造。
sources.does_not_support_en: The law establishes accessibility duties and the duty to keep traditional service channels. It sets none of this proposal's tolerance values and approves no specific spatial or constructional move.

sources.title: 生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法
sources.publisher: 国家互联网信息办公室等七部门
sources.source_locator: 第十四条、第十五条
sources.collection_method: 由本方案作者在国家互联网信息办公室官网读取规章全文，核对发布机关、公布与施行日期，并读取第十四条与第十五条正文；仅摘取与本方案停用规则和申诉时限直接对应的条款要义。
sources.license_or_reuse_terms: 国家机关公开发布的规章，依法公开。本包仅引述条款要义并注明条号。
sources.usage: 第十四条把「发现问题即停止生成与传输」确立为提供者义务，对应本方案的停用与全域暂停规则；第十五条要求设置便捷投诉入口并公布处理流程与反馈时限，对应本方案关于「没有时限的申诉权不可执行」的主张——该主张因此不是本方案的创新，而是对现行规章的落实。
sources.title_en: Interim Measures for the Management of Generative Artificial Intelligence Services
sources.collection_method_en: The author read the full measure on the Cyberspace Administration of China website, checked the issuing body and the promulgation and effective dates, and read Articles 14 and 15; only the substance bearing directly on this proposal's suspension rule and appeal time limit is extracted.
sources.license_or_reuse_terms_en: A regulation published by a state body, public by law. This package cites only the substance of the articles, with their numbers.
sources.usage_en: Article 14 makes stopping generation and transmission on discovery a provider's duty, matching this proposal's suspension and area-wide pause rules; Article 15 requires an accessible complaints channel with a published process and response time limit, matching this proposal's claim that an appeal right without a time limit is unenforceable — so that claim is not an invention here but an implementation of a rule already in force.
sources.does_not_support_zh: 第十四、十五条确立停止生成与投诉入口的义务，不规定处理时限的具体数值，也不构成对本方案 F1/F2/F3 分级或任何限差取值的授权。
sources.does_not_support_en: Articles 14 and 15 establish duties to stop generation and to provide a complaint channel. They fix no numeric response deadline and authorise neither this proposal's F1/F2/F3 tiers nor any tolerance value in them.

sources.title_en: State Council General Office notice issuing the Implementation Plan on Resolving the Difficulties Older People Face in Using Smart Technology (Guobanfa [2020] No. 45)
sources.collection_method_en: The author read the full policy text on the China Government Network, checked the document number, issuing body and date, and read the parallel-provision principle in the general requirements together with the list of five high-frequency service scenarios.
sources.license_or_reuse_terms_en: A policy document published by the State Council General Office, public by law.
sources.usage_en: Provides the policy basis for this proposal's hard constraint on persona P4: the plan requires traditional service methods to run in parallel with smart-service innovation, obliges everyday scenarios to retain the traditional methods older people know, and lists high-frequency matters this proposal's scenario cards can be compared against.
sources.evidence_class_note_zh: 本包原评为 regulatory_baseline，而组织方来源登记表把它的 usable_for_formal 限为 background_only。**登记表是本次征集的已发布契约，本包的评级高于它时以登记表为准**；该文件仍然被引用，只是不再被当作可支撑正式结论的依据。
sources.evidence_class_note_en: This package had graded it regulatory_baseline while the organisers' source registry caps its usable_for_formal at background_only. The registry is the published contract for this call, so where this package's grade was the stronger one the registry governs. The document is still cited; it no longer carries a formal conclusion.
sources.does_not_support_zh: 政策文件不是标准，不给出可校验的门槛值；不支持任何关于老年人实际使用率、满意度或到访频次的陈述。
sources.does_not_support_en: A policy document, not a standard: it supplies no testable threshold, and supports no claim about older people's actual usage, satisfaction or visit frequency.

sources.title_en: Measures for the Administration of Urban Design

sources.title_en: Measures for the Preparation and Approval of Regulatory Detailed Plans for Cities and Towns
sources.collection_method_en: The author read the full text on the China Government Network and checked the order number, promulgation and effective dates and chapter/article counts. **That check corrected a statement in this package**: the measure contains no article specifically enumerating the mandatory content of a regulatory detailed plan, so the matrix line requiring depth-related conclusions to distinguish known controls, design proposals and items awaiting confirmation is **this proposal's own paraphrase**, not the regulation's wording — stated here.
sources.license_or_reuse_terms_en: A ministerial regulation, public by law. This package cites it and marks the citation as a paraphrase.
sources.usage_en: Used to bound what this package may say at regulatory-plan depth: floor area ratio, building height, density, setbacks and road redlines fall within this measure's approval scope, are not supplied here, and stay unknown in metrics.json with their preconditions recorded.
sources.does_not_support_zh: 该办法界定容积率、建筑高度、密度、退线与道路红线的审批范畴；**正因如此本包不据它给出上述任何数值**，metrics.json 中保持 unknown 并记录前置条件。
sources.does_not_support_en: These measures place plot ratio, height, density, setbacks and road redlines inside an approval process. **That is precisely why this package publishes none of them**: they stay unknown in metrics.json with their preconditions recorded.

sources.title_en: Guide to the Classification of Land and Sea Use for Territorial Spatial Survey, Planning and Use Control
sources.collection_method_en: The author read the issuing notice on the China Government Network and checked the document number, issuing body and date. **The page states no effective date and does not declare the 2020 trial version repealed; both are recorded as found rather than inferred.** The land-use codes actually used here (16, 0802, 0702, 05, 0803, 1207, 1401) were taken from the enum the repository's site-package permits and compared item by item — **what constrains this package is that enum, not a code table it has not opened** — so no claim is made to have checked the classification system itself.
sources.license_or_reuse_terms_en: A ministerial normative document, public by law. This package cites only its existence and document number.
sources.usage_en: Land use is expressed with a checkable land_use_code rather than a classification invented here; final classification must rest on official documents and professional review.
sources.does_not_support_zh: 指南提供分类编码，不判定具体地块的用地归属；本包的 land_use_code 是表达口径，不是认定结论，最终归属以官方文件与专业论证为准。
sources.does_not_support_en: The guide supplies classification codes; it does not determine any parcel's classification. The land_use_code here is a way of expressing an intent, not a determination, and the final assignment rests with official documents and review.

source_quality_note_zh: 组织方在 `brief/source-quality-rules.md` 里发布了权威等级 A0–A3 与 X（不入库）以及时效等级 T0–T4。本包此前只用自己的证据上限（evidence_class），从未按这份已发布的分级说明自己的来源。此处补上：逐条给出 authority_level 与 timeliness_level，**并逐条核对没有任何一条落在 X（商业地图瓦片、账号内资料、下载密码资料、版权不明图片、非公开图件、个人信息）**。两条不属于该表所描述的类别，写明理由而不是硬套一个档次。**两条自采来源的 `timeliness_level` 此前整字段缺省**——当时只对 `authority_level` 写了「不属该表分档」的理由，而这句话声称的是逐条给出两个分级。现已补上，并写明 OSM 那条的 T0 指取回时刻、不指众包编辑的年龄（E202）。
source_quality_note_en: The organisers publish authority levels A0-A3 plus X (never indexed) and timeliness levels T0-T4 in brief/source-quality-rules.md. This package had only ever used its own evidence ceiling and had never described its sources in the published grading. Each source now carries an authority level and a timeliness level, and each was checked against X - commercial map tiles, account-gated or password-protected material, unclear-copyright images, non-public drawings, personal information - with none falling there. Two sources are outside what that table describes and say why rather than being forced into a level that does not fit. Both self-collected records had no `timeliness_level` field at all - the carve-out written at the time covered only the authority scale, while this sentence claims both are given for every record. They now carry T0, and the OSM record states that T0 is the retrieval moment and not the age of the crowd edits behind it (E202).

required_field_mapping_zh.note: 组织方在 `brief/source-quality-rules.md` 第 5 节列出「入库前必须记录」的十三项。本包此前用的是自己的一份十二项清单，并在闸门读数里称其为「同样的核心字段」——**同样的，指的是本包自己那一份。** 此处逐项对上，并写明哪一项由哪个字段回答。
required_field_mapping_zh.原始 URL: url（未取得者写明未取得，不给链接）
required_field_mapping_zh.权威等级: authority_level（组织方 A0–A3 分级，两条写明不属于该表）
required_field_mapping_zh.摘要: usage / usage_en —— **这一项是映射，不是新增字段**：本包记的是「该文件里本包据以立论的内容」，比一份通用摘要更窄也更可核验；写明是为了让读者知道这一项被什么回答，而不是假装两者相同。

case_join_note_zh: **六个国际案例与本登记表的联接，方向是从这里指向正文，而不是反过来。** 每条 `CASE-Cn-*` 的 `usage` 以正文案例表的行号 `Cn：` 开头，因此拿到本文件的人可以把六行逐一走到来源、URL、权威等级与访问日期。**正文里没有对应的 `[source:]` 内联引用，这是一个明写出来的取舍**：六条内联引用在英文版要花约 216 字节，而英文版此刻只剩几十字节（E135 记过它一度越限、构建却说 OK）。在「删掉别处的内容换取六个标记」与「把联接放在这份评审整份收到的文件里」之间，本包选了后者，并把理由写在这里而不是留给读者去猜。`sources_qa` 逐条核对这个联接：行号对不上即构建失败。
case_join_note_en: The join between the six international cases and this registry runs from here to the prose, not the other way. Each CASE-Cn record's usage begins with the row label Cn from the case table, so a reader holding this file can walk all six rows to their source, URL, authority level and access date. There is no inline [source:] citation in the prose, and that is a stated trade: six inline citations would cost about 216 bytes in the English edition, which has only tens to spare - E135 records the edition going over that cap while the build said OK. Between cutting content elsewhere to buy six markers and putting the join in a file the reviewer receives whole, this package chose the second and says so here rather than leaving it to be inferred. sources_qa checks the join row by row and fails the build if a label does not match.

rights_summary.why_here_zh: **版权与许可的逐文件台账在 `visual/assets/rights_ledger.json`，而组织方 2026-08-15 发布的 `review_input_access_boundary` 把它列在 `not_supplied_paths` 里**——评审收到的包中没有它的内容。新的评审提示同时写明：不得因为某件东西「没送到」就判定参赛者没有提交它，也不得声称看过它。因此这里不是重复台账，而是把**结论**放进评审整份读到的九份文件之一，让「版权是否清楚」这件事可以在它读得到的地方被判断（E210）。
rights_summary.why_here_en: The per-file copyright ledger is visual/assets/rights_ledger.json, and the organisers' review_input_access_boundary, published 15 August 2026, lists it under not_supplied_paths - its content is not in the packet the reviewer receives. The same prompt tells the reviewer not to treat an unsupplied artifact as proof of omission and not to claim to have inspected it. So this is not a copy of the ledger: it is the conclusion, placed in one of the nine files read whole, where whether the rights are clear can actually be judged (E210).
